name: Blue Prism
description: Connect your own Blue Prism estate (via Blue Prism Hub + Authentication Server v4.7+) to see and manage your processes, sessions, work queues, and runtime resources from Imperal -- list processes and start/stop sessions against them, manage work queue items, browse connected runtime resources, and read credential metadata. Uses your own Authentication Server Service Account (OAuth2 client credentials) -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself. Requires Blue Prism Hub + Authentication Server v4.7+; classic Blue Prism Server without Hub has no REST surface this connector can reach.

tools.name: connect_blue_prism
tools.description: Connect your Blue Prism estate (via Blue Prism Hub + Authentication Server v4.7+) by saving your Service Account's client_id/client_secret plus the Authentication Server URL and Hub/API base URL, after checking the credentials actually work. Requires Blue Prism Hub + Authentication Server v4.7+ -- classic Blue Prism Server without Hub has no REST surface this connector can reach.

auth_server_url.description: Your Blue Prism Authentication Server URL, e.g. https://yourhub.example.com/authserver
auth_server_url.title: Auth Server Url

api_base_url.description: Your Blue Prism Hub/API base URL, e.g. https://yourhub.example.com/api
api_base_url.title: Api Base Url

client_id.description: Authentication Server Service Account client ID.
client_id.title: Client Id

client_secret.description: Authentication Server Service Account client secret.
client_secret.title: Client Secret

label.description: Optional friendly name for this Blue Prism estate connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected Blue Prism estates.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: disconnect_blue_prism
tools.description: Disconnect one Blue Prism estate. Nothing in Blue Prism itself is changed; only the saved credentials here are deleted.

connection_id.description: Connection id to disconnect, from list_connections.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: List processes available in the connected Blue Prism estate.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_process
tools.description: Read one Blue Prism process in full.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List recent sessions (process runs) in the connected Blue Prism estate, most recent first, optionally filtered by process.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

process_id.description: Optional process id to filter sessions to.
process_id.title: Process Id

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Read one session in full -- status, timing, resource, and any error info.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a session: run a process now, either on explicit runtime resources or by letting Blue Prism pick, with optional input parameters.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

process_id.description: Process id to run, from list_processes.
process_id.title: Process Id

resource_ids.description: Explicit runtime resource ids to run on. Omit to let Blue Prism pick.
resource_ids.title: Resource Ids

inputs.description: Optional input parameters for the process.
inputs.title: Inputs

tools.name: stop_session
tools.description: Stop a running session: 'stop' for graceful stop, 'terminate' to force-kill immediately.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

session_id.description: Session id to stop, from list_sessions.
session_id.title: Session Id

action.description: 'stop' for graceful stop, 'terminate' to force-kill immediately.
action.title: Action

tools.name: list_work_queues
tools.description: List Work Queues configured in the connected Blue Prism estate -- the queue/queue-item pattern used for high-volume unattended work.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_queue_items
tools.description: List items in a Work Queue, optionally filtered by status ('Pending', 'Locked', 'Completed', 'Exception').

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: add_queue_item
tools.description: Add a new work item to a Work Queue -- the payload a process will pick up and process.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

queue_id.description: Work queue id to add the item to, from list_work_queues.
queue_id.title: Queue Id

key_value.description: The queue item's key value (its unique business identifier).
key_value.title: Key Value

tools.name: set_queue_item_status
tools.description: Manually set a queue item's outcome to 'Completed' or 'Exception'.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List registered Runtime Resources in the connected Blue Prism estate -- their name, status, and resource pool.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_credentials
tools.description: List Credential Vault entries in the connected Blue Prism estate -- name and type only, never the secret value.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: bulk_stop_sessions
tools.description: Stop several running Sessions in one call, by explicit session ids. Continues past per-item failures and reports each outcome.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

session_ids.description: Explicit session ids to act on.
session_ids.title: Session Ids

action.description: 'stop' for graceful stop, 'terminate' to force-kill immediately.
action.title: Action

tools.name: audit_estate
tools.description: Build one aggregated health report across every Runtime Resource in the connected Blue Prism estate: resource status, exception queue item counts, and running session counts.

connection_id.description: Which connected estate to use. Omit if only one is connected.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: bp_connections
secrets.description: Your connected Blue Prism estates -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per estate, each with its own Authentication Server Service Account (client_id, client_secret) and auth_server_url/api_base_url pair. Managed through connect_blue_prism / disconnect_blue_prism -- you should not need to edit this directly.
